text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — Collov Labs introduced NewEyes AI, an agent using glasses, earphones and memory for real-world context. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5855)

2 — A post describes Anthropic research warning of AI worms that replicate and run across vulnerable consumer devices. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5856)

3 — Reason Machines claims its free harness beats Codex+Astra on Terminal-Bench 4.0 at 22% lower cost. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5858)

4 — A post reports Fable 5.5 in Azure's model catalog, citing a LiteLLM commit adding support. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5859)

5 — a16z says ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Suno, Photoroom, Notion and Canva rank in the top 50 for web, mobile and revenue. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5860)

6 — ScaleDown announced classification, extraction and summarization models with 1M-token multimodal input and free output. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5861)

7 — Google's Logan Kilpatrick announced Gemini 4 Argon's rollout, highlighting coding improvements and 1M-token output. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5863)

8 — Clueso says it raised a $10M Series A to automate corporate video creation and serves over 1,000 organizations. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5864)

9 — A creator showcased Gemini 4 Argon artwork made with code, sharing code for 534 paintings. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5865)

10 — Sundar Pichai announced Argon access via paid APIs, Antigravity Ultra, and Pro/Ultra subscriptions in Gemini and Search. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5866)

11 — Anthropic says it replaced git with its Scion source-control system in five months as daily merges exceeded 30,000. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5867)

12 — Liquid AI released open-weight LFM2.5-24B-A2B for local agents, with 2B active parameters and 131K-token context. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5868)

13 — Pichai says Argon turned a Pixel CAD file into a Blender animation, refining its work over 1,000 iterations. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5869)

14 — Unusual Whales quotes Palantir's CTO claiming some AI researchers start smoking because they expect AI to cure cancer. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5870)

15 — OpenAI says an employee planted a recording device and was arrested, with no indication of model, code or customer-data theft. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5871)

16 — Physical Intelligence opened its Pi API beta to more teams adapting its models to robots and industrial applications. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5872)

17 — Induction Labs says higher budgets widen agent performance gaps, while its best agent, Opus 5.5, still trails humans. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5873)

18 — OpenCode says Cat Jam, a stealth agentic coding model, is available free with zero data retention. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5874)

19 — Meta introduced Your algorithm, letting Facebook users shape Feed and Reels recommendations in their own words. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5875)

20 — ReRoute researchers report better scientific what-if predictions using partial physics knowledge without new intervention data. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5876)

21 — Prime Intellect announced its acquisition of Moondream to integrate open vision models and inference optimizations. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5877)

22 — Stanford's Deep Learning Alchemy course emphasizes hands-on experiments and prediction quizzes, allowing AI on assignments. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5878)

--Hermes.
